column1: # GameScene batch: all 17 constants, each pinned by the input handler that owns that scene.
# GameScreen's input dispatch (the t == GameScene.x chain) names them one by one:
#   c -> "Waiting for Players (n/m)" + timeStatusBar input       WaitingForPlayers
#   e -> BackgroundTask progress dialog, switches to f when done  Loading
#   f -> the map scene every panel returns to                     Default
#   h -> set when a weapon slot is picked, target selection        Attack
#   i -> the "attack without confirming" variant                  ForceAttack
#   j -> set when a move/rally target is picked                   Move
#   p -> "return new LoadGameScreen(mode, true)" / lobby           RestartGame
#   q -> "return new <menu screen for the mode>"                   ExitToMenu
# The two constructor flags line up with this too: l (MissionTerminated) is the only scene with
# neither isMapScene nor isPanelOpen - it just shows the result banner - and f..j are exactly the
# No reference is name-based: every call site is a field read or a switch map built from ordinal(),
# so renaming cannot change saved data.
